Thanks for the ping — I'll lead the session. Confirming availability for Tue Mar 3 at 16:00 UTC.

Prep notes / what I'll bring:
- High-level architecture slide that maps controls to SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2/1.3 in transit, support for customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) and HSM-backed keys for Dedicated/Private deployments. I'll enumerate trade-offs for BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys.
- Audit logs: event taxonomy (auth events, API calls, admin actions), retention defaults (90 days), configurable retention and S3/splunk export options. I'll confirm log schema and an example export flow.
- SSO: SAML metadata, OIDC client setup, SCIM provisioning support.
- Evidence: I'll bring our SOC 2 readiness checklist and a sanitized set of control mappings. We will not share vendor-sensitive artifacts but can provide SOC 2 report under NDA / secure link.

Requests for Finserv ahead of the call:
1) Confirm if Sam wants logs forwarded to a Splunk index (provide index name).
2) Confirm whether Finserv requires HSM-based key custody or customer KMS is sufficient.

I will create a short agenda and upload the architecture PDF to the Drive link Marissa mentioned.

-Vivek
